newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S DOWNHILL TRAINING POSTPONED.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S DOWNHILL TRAINING POSTPONED.

text.p: A women's World Cup downhill training run was called off on Wednesday due to warm temperatures at the Austrian resort which softened piste conditions, organisers said.
Instead, two training runs for the back-to-back downhill races on January 10 and 11, have been scheduled for Thursday, weather permitting.
Organisers were mending the Strohsack slope on Wednesday with the artificial salt PTX which is used to harden snow. They said a cold front was forecast for the weekend's weather.
Friday's planned downhill at Bad Kleinkirchheim replaces a downhill called off in Crans Montana, Switzerland, last December.
Bad Kleinkirchheim is also due to stage a super-giant slalom on Sunday.
